The adjustable +-15dB two band active EQ allows players to dial in their sound with pinpoint accuracy and adds a HUGE range of harmonic content to the player’s overall sound. Because this pedal is so transparent, many players find that they’ll leave it on at all times! True Bypass for eliminating any signal interference when switched off.
